param.name: wind_correction_factor
param.label: Wind height correction factor (10 m to 2 m)
param.help: Multiplies the 10 m wind speed to estimate it at 2 m, the STICS reference height. 0.7 ≈ ln(2/0.03)/ln(10/0.03) (logarithmic profile). Set to 1.0 to disable the correction.

param.name: epsg
param.label: Projection of the NetCDF grid (EPSG code)
param.help: For example EPSG:4326 (WGS84 longitude/latitude), EPSG:2154 (Lambert-93) or EPSG:27572 (extended Lambert II, SAFRAN and DRIAS grids).

param.name: shapefile_zip
param.label: Spatial cells shapefile (ZIP archive)
param.help: ZIP archive with the .shp, .shx, .dbf and .prj files. Polygons need an integer 'cell' column: it becomes the cell ID of the STICS files, and the daily values of the grid pixels inside each polygon are averaged. @ABSENT_HELP@

expand.absent_help: If no shapefile is given, every grid pixel becomes its own cell, numbered 0..N-1 in row-major order.

param.name: cell_id_column
param.label: Cell / site ID column
param.help: Column identifying each spatial cell or site; it becomes the name of the STICS files. Non-integer IDs (site names) are numbered 1..N in sorted order, the correspondence being written to the log. If no column is selected, all rows are treated as a single site with ID 1.

validator.message: The selected dataset has no columns.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Daily climate table
param.help: Comma, semicolon, tab or pipe separated, with a header line. Lines starting with '#' are skipped. Expected columns: @VARIABLES@.
